item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:55 HKT 27/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. With the monsoon moderating in the middle and latter parts of this week, temperatures will rise over the coast of southern China, but an upper-air disturbance will bring showers to the region. A humid southerly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week and early next week.
